title: Maths Knowledge Graph options
description: Reference schema for the maths-knowledge-graph configuration mapping. It is supplied for explicit external validation; the extension does not register automatic Quarto editor integration. The native filter remains authoritative for effective rebased paths and its UTF-8 byte bounds.

enabled.description: Enable mathematical catalogue validation, finite templates and optional notation. False leaves native source unchanged without reading catalogue or registry files.

declarations.description: Local literal JSON catalogue. Default knowledge.json is resolved from the project root or standalone document directory; an explicit effective path follows Quarto's inherited metadata rebasing.

notation.description: Optional local literal JSON notation registry, using notation.schema.json. Absence disables notation authoring; it does not request a network resource or a model.

localJsonPath.description: Relative local path with no controls, URI scheme, query or fragment. Forward/backslash separators are admitted. Effective dot components must resolve lexically within the trusted project/document root; the filter does not claim real-path confinement of symlinks or junctions. The native 4096 limit is UTF-8 bytes; JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points. No filename extension is inferred or enforced.
